response: ["The case is routed to melanoma (MEL) for management recommendations.", "The licensed guideline corpus provides guidance for initial local management.", "According to PMID 30392755, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.", "The same guideline also recommends surgical excision for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.", "According to PMID 39709737, recommendation 1: when melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.", "The consensus rate for recommendation 1 is 100% (21/21)."]
